headline: identity.* modeling-rule migration sweeps 90 packs; new Databricks and Akamai Prolexic collectors
summary_md:
- The **identity.\*** modeling-rule migration lands across nine tracked PRs (CRTX-271521 and CRTX-271524, parts 2 through 7), which is what puts 90 packs on the board in one day.
- 78 of those packs are pure additions over a single changed line — the migration adds fields, it does not rewrite the rules already there.
- Two brand-new packs arrive: a **Databricks** integration pack (13,081 lines) and an **Akamai Prolexic** event collector (1,820 lines).
- Larger reworks land in **CrowdStrike Falcon** (asset fetching), **GCP** (command alignment) and **ServiceNow v2**.
- A separate commit covers legacy packs the identity.\* migration could only land by force-merge.

highlights.title: identity.* fields added to modeling rules across the estate
highlights.detail: CRTX-271521 and CRTX-271524 ship as numbered parts of seven, and account for the long tail of packs that gained roughly 50–400 lines against one deletion.

highlights.title: New Databricks integration pack
highlights.detail: The single largest change of the day at 13,081 insertions and no deletions, landing as a new pack rather than an extension of an existing one.

highlights.title: New Akamai Prolexic event collector
highlights.detail: CIAC-16080 adds a collector for Akamai's DDoS mitigation service — 1,820 insertions, also entirely new.

highlights.title: CrowdStrike Falcon asset fetching reworked
highlights.detail: 3,403 insertions against 902 deletions, the day's only large two-way rewrite, described upstream as fetch-assets improvements.

highlights.title: GCP commands realigned
highlights.detail: CRTX-270723 replaces 431 lines with 1,252, the shape of a command surface being renamed or restructured rather than extended.

highlights.title: Legacy packs needed a force-merge to take the migration
highlights.detail: CRTX-271527 and CRTX-271522 are called out separately as legacy packs requiring force-merge, so those packs' rules were overwritten rather than merged.

items.Packs/Databricks: New integration pack, 13,081 insertions and no deletions.
items.Packs/CrowdStrikeFalcon: Asset fetching reworked: 3,403 insertions against 902 deletions.
items.Packs/ServiceNow: ServiceNow v2 fix (CRTX-208419), 744 insertions against 252 deletions.

items.Packs/CiscoASA: Modeling rule modified — a seven-line change.
items.Packs/VMwareVCenter: vcsa-audit pid mapping fixed to use to_integer (CRTX-276239).

items.Packs/Palo_Alto_Networks_Enterprise_DLP: Uses the client-credentials flow when that flow is selected (XSUP-75518).
items.Packs/Palo_Alto_Networks_WildFire: Fix for behaviour with an empty API key (XSUP-75894).
items.Packs/MailSenderNew: The "(New)" text is removed from the Mail Sender integration name (CIAC-17814).
